# ADR-NNN: Concrete decision title

- Status: proposed / accepted / superseded.
- Date: YYYY-MM-DD.
- Owner/reviewer: name.
- Related phase and specifications: relative links.
- Supersedes/superseded by: link when applicable.

## Context

Describe the problem, constraints, risks and measured evidence. Distinguish actual observations from assumptions and include dated primary references for external constraints.

## Options

Describe viable options and their concrete costs/tradeoffs. Explain why rejected options do not fit the constraints without broad technology claims.

## Decision

State the chosen behavior, boundaries, ownership and public contracts. If provisional, identify the experiment/release gate required before relying on it.

## Consequences

Record expected benefits, remaining risks, operational costs, security/privacy/accessibility effects, migration/compatibility implications and necessary changes to the roadmap/docs.

## Verification and revisit

List evidence that validates the decision and concrete triggers that reopen it: failed spike, new policy, changed audience/load, unsupported upgrade or observed reliability/cost. Preserve the historical decision if later superseded.
